title: ApplianceCare AI — Refrigerator Diagnostic Knowledge Base — GL-D201ABCD
scope: LG India public support FAQ and product pages reviewed on 2026-10-12, plus clearly-labelled proposed diagnostic branches.

model.name: LG 185 L Direct Cool Single Door Refrigerator
model.controls: Manual temperature knob; direct-cool defrost button referenced in LG's general Direct Cool FAQ

official_sources.title: LG GL-D201ABCD product page
content_covered: manual knob/reciprocating compressor specs on product page

global_rules: Ask one diagnostic question at a time.
Support selectable answers and natural-language/free-text responses.
If the answer is uncertain, offer an 'I'm not sure' branch rather than guessing.
Use model-specific controls only after matching the full model code.
Never claim a compressor, thermostat, PCB, refrigerant system, or sensor has failed solely from a symptom.
Do not tell customers to open panels, handle wiring, bypass protection, remove electrical covers, or manipulate refrigerant.
If burning smell, smoke, sparks, damaged cable, repeated breaker trip, or water near electrical parts is reported, stop routine troubleshooting and escalate.
For persistent symptoms after the official safe checks, route to authorized service.
The LG FAQ's stabilizer wattage recommendations are not hard-coded as a chatbot instruction; verify product and installation requirements before recommending accessories.
Question wording, aliases, and branching order marked proposed are chatbot design suggestions, not a verbatim LG chatbot script.

scenarios.title: No cooling at all

questions.text: Is the refrigerator receiving power?
Does the interior light or display turn on when the door is opened?
Is the temperature control set to a cooling setting rather than OFF?
Was the refrigerator recently plugged in, moved, or restarted after a power cut?
After correcting the setting and allowing time for cooling, is it cooling now?

scenarios.source_basis: LG FAQ has separate no-cooling advice for Direct Cool and Frost Free: temperature control not OFF; Direct Cool defrost button may be pressed; set temperature appropriately; low-voltage advice appears on LG's FAQ. Stabilizer sizing is not automatically recommended here because installation requirements must be verified for the exact model.
scenarios.source_status: Official FAQ basis; question sequence and some branches are proposed chatbot logic.

branch_actions.power_off: Ask customer to confirm the wall switch/socket is on and the plug is firmly seated only if safely accessible. Do not ask them to open electrical parts. If outlet or cable is damaged, stop and call a qualified electrician/service.

branch_actions.set_control: For GL-D201ABCD, set the temperature knob to a normal cooling setting; LG's general Direct Cool FAQ recommends High/7 for no-cooling triage. Do not apply this knob instruction to a different control layout.

branch_actions.allow_stabilization: Keep doors closed and allow the appliance time to stabilize after setup or a power interruption. If cooling does not return, continue diagnosis.
branch_actions.q5_cooling: Continue based on the answer; do not infer a specific component failure from this symptom alone.
branch_actions.resolved: Confirm stable cooling and close the troubleshooting flow.

scenarios.title: Low cooling / food not cold enough

questions.text: Which part is not cooling properly?
Is the temperature setting appropriate for the current weather and food load?
Is food packed tightly or are air passages blocked by food?
Is the refrigerator covered, too close to a wall, or near a heat source?
Does the door close completely and is the gasket clean?
After these safe checks, has cooling improved?
Is the freezer temperature control set appropriately for the season and load?

scenarios.source_basis: LG FAQ lists incorrect setting, insufficient ventilation, covered body, insufficient food spacing, door not fully closed, heat sources; Frost Free FAQ also mentions freezer controller setting. Direct Cool FAQ mentions periodic manual defrost.
scenarios.source_status: Official FAQ basis; diagnostic order and resolution checks are proposed.

branch_actions.adjust_setting: Adjust the temperature setting according to the exact model manual and food load. LG's general FAQ recommends setting the Direct Cool knob according to weather/food load; do not blindly apply a numbered setting to another control.
branch_actions.check_manual: Use the model-specific manual to identify the recommended setting; do not invent a temperature value if the control is not labelled.
branch_actions.rearrange_food: Leave gaps between items and avoid blocking air outlets/airflow paths. Do not overload the freezer.
branch_actions.inspect_food_spacing: Ask the customer to check for blocked vents or tightly packed food, then rearrange if needed.
branch_actions.correct_placement: Keep the appliance uncovered, with ventilation clearance. LG's FAQ says at least 10 cm from rear and side walls; follow the model's installation manual if it specifies different clearances. Keep away from stove, microwave, direct sunlight, and other heat sources.

branch_actions.clean_reseat_door: Remove obstructions, clean the gasket with a damp cloth, and close the door fully. Do not use tools or chemicals on the gasket.
branch_actions.inspect_door: Inspect whether packages or shelves prevent the door from closing; check the gasket visually.
branch_actions.adjust_freezer_setting: Set the freezer control according to the model manual and seasonal/food-load guidance. Exact control markings vary.
branch_actions.resolved: Confirm the refrigerator reaches and maintains normal cooling; close the flow.
branch_actions.monitor_and_recheck: Keep doors closed and monitor. If cooling continues to decline, escalate.
branch_actions.service_escalation: Arrange authorized service if safe checks do not restore cooling. Do not diagnose refrigerant or compressor faults from symptoms alone.

scenarios.diagnosis_policy: Do not claim a component has failed based only on symptom answers. Use 'possible cause' only when supported; escalate uncertain or persistent faults.

terminal_outcomes.assistant_action: Confirm the issue is resolved and summarize safe steps completed.
Offer authorized service; capture model, serial number, symptom, onset, checks tried, and safety flags.
Stop routine troubleshooting; advise safe isolation only if safe and direct the customer to qualified help.
